24370.title: NEGOTIATING ISLAMIC UNITY IN A FRAGMENTED WORLD
24370.authors: Moh. Azwar Hairul, Mustaqimah, Ahmed Abdul Malik, Basri
24370.abstract: This study examines the phrase ummatan wāḥidah in contemporary Sunni and Shi‘i Qur’anic exegesis by comparing Wahbah al-Zuhaylī’s al-Tafsīr al-Munīr and Husayn Faḍlullah’s Min Waḥy al-Qur’ān. The background of this research lies in the enduring tension between Sunni and Shi‘i traditions, which historically framed Qur’anic interpretation as a contested domain of authority and identity. While earlier exegetical works often reinforced sectarian divisions, contemporary interpretations increasingly revisit the Qur’an as a source of unity. 9907.title: Lafaz Kebahagiaan dalam Tafsir Al-Azhar
9907.journal: QURANICUM: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
9907.abstract: One of the hopes and goals that humans want to achieve is happiness. This can be seen from the fact that humans try their best to achieve happiness in their lives. In the Qur'an happiness is expressed through various sentences and statements that express joy, pleasure, victory which is the foundation of human hope in life. The word that means happiness in the Qur'an is mentioned using several words, such as the word falāḥ, fawzan, fariḥa with various variations of each word. The purpose of the research is to find out the definition of happiness in the Qur'an, the lafaẓ expression of happiness in the Qur'an using Tafsir al-Azhar. 27236.abstract: Meâlimü’t-tenzîl; müfessir, muhaddis ve fakîh kimliğiyle bilinen Beğavî’nin (ö. 516/1122) kaleme aldığı önemli eserlerden biridir. 1284.title: Mü minûn Sûresindeki Kıraat Farklılıkları ve Tefsire Etkisi
1284.abstract: , Mehmet Efe Bu makalede kıraat farklılıklarının tefsire etkisi, Mü’minûn Sûresi özelinde ele alınmıştır. Çalışma mütevâtir ve meşhûr imamların kıraatleri olmak üzere on kıraat dediğimiz “kıraat-ı aşere” metodu esas alınarak yapılmıştır. Kıraat farklılıllarının tefsire etkisinin niteliğini anlamak için başta kıraat ve tefsir kitapları esas alınarak konuyla ilgili dil bilgisi kitaplarına da başvuru yapılmıştır. 25449.title: Qur'anic Ethics and Domestic Morality: The Indonesian Ministry of Religious Affairs' Exegesis and Contemporary Family Resilience
25449.authors: Siti Kanzun Najah Wassurur, Siti Asiah, Muhyidin Azmi
25449.abstract: Amid growing concerns over divorce and domestic violence in Indonesia, reconstructing an applicable Qur’anic ethical framework for family life has become an urgent socio-religious imperative. This study examined how the Indonesian Ministry of Religious Affairs’ exegesis, Tafsir Kemenag, reformulates household morality and connects textual hermeneutics with contemporary family resilience. A qualitative library-research design was employed, integrating thematic exegesis (tafsīr mawḍūʿī) with textual discourse analysis. 2093.title: KONSEP AL-NAFS DALAM AL-QUR´AN MENURUT KITAB IBNU KATSIR
2093.journal: Al-Munir: Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
2093.abstract: This study aims to conduct an in-depth analysis of the concept of Al-Nafs in the understanding and Book of Tafsir written by Ibn Kathir. The concept of Nafs itself is one of the important parts in the aspect of human life as a whole being that has spiritual and physical elements. This study was conducted using the library research method with the content analysis technique where the author conducted a study of the book of tafsir written by Ibn Kathir which discusses the concept of Al-Nafs. In Ibn Kathir's interpretation, there are several verses in the Qur'an that discuss in detail about Al-Nafs.
